title: Dot's outfit emporium
description: a collection of outfits for vanity and style
body:
a mod that adds outfits meant for vanity all armors included are made by me and arent meant for actual use as they have base stats and none of them do anything special best paired with accessorize mod as to be used in the vanity slot

currently adds
pioneer set (hat chest boots)
tinkerer set (hat chest legs)

(only creative no recipes)

TODO
the goal for this mod is to add sets of vanity that look cool and cute whilst also not swaying too far from minecraft and in the future will have a lootbox style craftable item to randomly get items to collect them in survival
